domains.description: Domains this provider covers. Subdomains are included.

except.description: Paths where this provider's rules don't apply (global rules still do).

id.description: Must match the file name: `id = "x"` lives in `x.toml`.

keep.description: Parameters that make links work. Never removed, even if a global rule matches.

redirect.description: Redirect links on these domains, replaced by the link they lead to.

remove.description: Tracking parameters to remove on these domains.

strip_unknown.description:
Remove every parameter not listed in `keep`. For sites whose links work without query
parameters and that keep inventing new tracking names (e.g. Instagram).

test.description: Example links and their expected cleaned version. At least one.

reason.description: Why this is tracking, in plain words. Shown in docs and can be shown in the app.

Redirect.description:
A page that only records the click and forwards to another link, which it carries in a
parameter, e.g. `google.com/url?q=<link>`. Such links are replaced by the link they carry
(cleaned too). Tests of it need `needs = ["redirect"]`.

params.description: Parameters that may hold the destination, tried in order, e.g. `["q", "url"]`.

path.description: The redirect page's path, exactly, e.g. `/url` (`/` for the domain's root).

reason.description: What the redirect is for, in plain words.

in.description: A link as shared by the app.

needs.description: Rule features this test relies on (see [`FEATURES`]), e.g. `["redirect"]`.
